facts.fact: The chief of the national identity-titles production centre, a police divisional commissioner, says the new biometric national ID card is now delivered within 48 hours as the decree provides, with applicants collecting it at police stations.

CMR.note: Nothing on other registers using the ID number.

facts.fact: VOA Afrique reports that production of the new biometric national ID cards within 48 hours is effective in Cameroon, with the first applicants having received their cards, under a presidential decree of 28 February 2025.

CMR.note: Card production only; nothing on station records of reports or cases.
